column20: Conselara Labs verified single-node DGX Spark benchmark: 2,053 tok/s prefill (2k prompt) & 57.5-60.0 tok/s pure decode.
Verified by Conselara Labs on 2x DGX Spark over 200GbE QSFP112. Note: gptq_marlin (17.0 tok/s) beats NVFP4 (11.73 tok/s) on SM121.
Actual benchmark from vllm-mlx Discussion #637 on M5 Max 128GB: IELTS scoring workload across concurrency c=1 to c=15.
27B dense model in 4.5-bit (~15.2GB weights + 4.6GB KV cache). 614 GB/s roofline = 40.4 tok/s; achieves 33.5 tok/s (83% eff).
Near-lossless 8-bit dense 27B on M5 Ultra (1,200 GB/s / 27 GB = 44.4 tok/s roofline; 36.2 tok/s = 81.5% bandwidth efficiency).
320B total params in 4.25-bit requires ~170GB weights + 16GB KV = 186GB (fits in 256GB M5 Ultra, NOT 128GB). 18B active -> 125 tok/s roofline.
Reconciles old EXP-006 row: 28.5GB footprint in 6-bit is physically GLM-4.7-Flash-30B-A3B (22.5GB weights + 6GB KV), NOT 320B GLM-5.3.
552B MoE backbone quantized to 2.75-bit (~190GB RAM) + 196B Engram lookup streamed from NVMe SSD (~22GB active cache).
